notes.content:
Small patch/update:
- New system to communicate data to Steamworks.

notes.content:
[b]Small patch/update:[/b]

- UNHERD final fight bug fix (UNHERD no longer uses physics).

- Materials update for breakables in level 18.

[b]*Special thanks to nupali.[/b]

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE 1.7
notes.content:
[b]Small patch/update:[/b]

- Japanese "ワ" glyph missing added.
- Wating time Mechanic change. You now lose the amount of time you were supposed to wait (in a few seconds), from your in-game time. 
- Minor adjustments on levels.

notes.title: KING BUG UPDATE 1.6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747931677036214819/D478CD078F16D3E6E47F2A6E9494D27E237ED9E4/[/img]

[b]Small patch/update:
[/b]
- Minor Chinchilla jump bugs fix.
- Hiden objects now have a "discover" animation.
- Pear Challenge bug fix.
- RodBag cosmetic added.
- New Character Bug King added.
- Hats now only show if it's the first time you encounter them.
- Minor adjustments on levels.
- Chinchilla has now 2% less fur.

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE 1.5
notes.content:
[b]Small patch/update:
[/b]
- Minor Chinchilla bugs fix.
- The time counter in levels now shows hours and minutes.
- Initial hearts count now varies depending on the selected difficulty.
- Spiders UI weird behavior fix.
- Enemies falling from stages at level completion fix.
- Level 1 dialogue bug fix.
- Chinchilla has now 14% more fur.

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE 1.4
notes.content:
[b]Small patch/update:[/b]

- Leaderboard list bug fix.
- Spiders not jumping bug fix.
- You can now share the game more than once.
- You can now Invert the Y-axis on settings/controls.
- Some Performance improvements.

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE 1.3
notes.content:
[b]Small patch/update:
[/b]
- Lock mouse to screen.
- Add more range to Horizontal Camera speed.
- Chinchilla movement tweaks.
- Small changes in Levels 4,12,17,18.
- Now you have 50 lives at the start of the game.
- "Time is up" now gives you 30 lives instead of 15.

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Small patch/update:
[/b]
- Doble jump & Wall jump added.
- Jump Scalable Speed added.
- Overall Darkness reduce by 10%.
- Vertical Camera manipulation w/ Input added.

notes.content:

[b]- Tweaks some menu and mechanics issues[/b]

notes.title: Update notes for 16/02/2021
notes.content: As some players wanted to take more control over the camera, we added new capabilities to the current system, now you can control where the camera is looking with the Controller w/ Input or use the default (automatic).
